name: blackswan-worldmodel
description: The WORLD-MODEL probe — a driver-conditioned directional timing model (the B4 'world model' line, generalised beyond crypto). Instead of reading price, it reads an asset's economically-motivated FUNDAMENTAL DRIVERS point-in-time and takes a long/short/flat position from their past-only trend — the disciplined version of 'model what moves this asset and predict it'. The seed case is GOLD with its three canonical macro drivers: the 10y real rate (DFII10 — gold rises when it FALLS), the broad dollar (DTWEXBGS — gold rises when it FALLS), and the 10y inflation breakeven (DGS10-DFII10 — gold rises when it RISES). The driver set is declared per asset (DRIVER_SETS), so any commodity can get its own world model without engine changes. worldmodel is the thesis; worldmodel_inverse is the mirror control that must FAIL if the drivers carry real directional content. Gold has a strong secular uptrend, so return_vs_hold is exposure-biased — the honest decider is the model's own DSR-deflated oos_sharpe, with sharpe_vs_hold reported alongside. Macro joined POINT-IN-TIME via pit_fusion (the leakage guard); the side decided at day t sets the position for day t+1; positions never read price. Guards mutation-proven in test_worldmodel.py: past-only driver trend, the breakeven spread reads two DISTINCT series, all-drivers-defined composite, next-bar causality. Deterministic and model-free (the seed is contract-only).

asset.description: Which asset is traded and whose drivers condition the position. GOLD/SILVER use the precious-metal monetary drivers; COPPER uses a financial-conditions set (its real China/inventory drivers are not in the mined macro set). Each asset pairs with its declared driver_set.

signal.description: worldmodel takes the driver-implied side (long when the majority of drivers are bullish, short when bearish, flat on a tie); worldmodel_inverse flips the sign — the control that must FAIL if the drivers carry real directional content. An unknown value is refused.

driver_set.description: The declared fundamental drivers. gold_macro3 = real rate (DFII10↓) + USD (DTWEXBGS↓) + breakeven (DGS10-DFII10↑) — DFII10 double-counted, kept only to reproduce the first probe. gold_macro3b / silver_macro3 = the DE-COLLINEARISED precious-metal set (breakeven from the standalone T10YIE, DFII10 once). copper_macro3 = a financial-conditions set (USD↓ + real rate↓ + growth curve T10Y2Y↑), deliberately incomplete (misses China demand / LME inventories).

lookback.description: Daily bars behind the past-only trend comparison for each driver (a driver votes bullish when its scalar has moved in the bullish direction over this window). 21/63/126 ~ 1/3/6 months.

transaction_fee.description: Per-side fee, charged on turnover when the composite side switches (~0.1% round trip). The world model is low-turnover (macro regimes are persistent), so cost is not the enemy — the signal's skill is.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED (train is the expanding window before it, warming the trend + as-of macro). 2022 (aggressive Fed hiking / rising real rates / strong USD — a gold headwind) and 2024 (gold record highs, decoupled from its macro drivers) are the decisive pair: a real world model must time gold in BOTH.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the backtest is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept.
